discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B012. 30 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains passed every time. Mainly Disney Pins Blog weekly/event posts, plus MyPinCentral, Disney Fashionista, Carstairs Considers, disneygeek, MiceChat. Resellers (ecrater, distradingpins4u, yourwdwstore, disneythemepark.biz, pintrader.club) and disneypinforum seen but not used as evidence. Reuses B012 keys (HMH 2018, ugly sweater, Lunar New Year, MHP). New: Window of Evil series (DLR-only, excluded by B010), Channel 28 PTN Aug 2018, DCA Food & Wine 2018, Club 33 Shag box/1901, Halloween CM Evil Queen, AP holiday ornament set. No B012 holds released; holds kept on tarot, ugly sweater, Mysterious Shadows box. No OE added (418 covers). No prompt-injection seen.
